We are looking for a compassionate, experienced and motivated Doula to join the Susan Samueli Integrative Health Institute’s (SSIHI) Integrative Maternal-Child Wellness Program, an interdisciplinary program that supports individuals and families across the first 1,000 days — preconception, pregnancy, the postpartum “fourth trimester,” infancy and toddlerhood — by combining individualized naturopathic and nutrition care with group-based education, culinary nutrition, mindfulness and mind-body practices, acupuncture, movement, health coaching, and ongoing program evaluation and research. The Doula will provide patient-centered, non-clinical support and education to individuals during pregnancy, childbirth preparation and, with particular emphasis, the postpartum period, including lactation and infant feeding, postpartum recovery, newborn care, infant sleep, maternal mental health and adjustment to parenthood. Support is delivered through a hybrid model of one-on-one check-ins (in person and virtual), live group sessions and office hours co-facilitated with the program’s naturopathic doctor, registered dietitian and other team members, and asynchronous educational resources delivered through the program’s digital platform. Responsibilities include providing one-on-one support, offering guidance on comfort measures and coping strategies, facilitating patient education, supporting birth planning and postpartum adjustment, reinforcing the nutrition, sleep and mind-body practices introduced by program clinicians, recognizing concerns that fall outside the doula scope of practice, connecting patients with appropriate clinical, social and community resources, and supporting participant engagement, retention and completion of program assessments. The Doula will collaborate with healthcare professionals to promote continuity of care, empower patients to make informed decisions, and support the physical and emotional well-being of patients and their families. Using knowledge of doula practices, integrative health and patient care, the incumbent will exercise sound judgment in adapting support and educational approaches to individual patient needs while adhering to applicable institutional policies, procedures, research protocols and professional boundaries.
Competency in the delivery of individualized birth and/or postpartum doula care to perinatal and postpartum individuals, infants, and families
